groups.title: Universal Library Ingestion & Knowledge Graph Pipelines

entries.title: elizabethsiegle/cfworkers-ai-translate
entries.submitted_scope: Multimodal audio and text translator running Meta's m2m100-1.2b model natively on Workers AI.
entries.available_scope: M2M100 text translation. For audio, use #004 first.

entries.title: genie-oh/rrv7-cf-i18n-starter
entries.submitted_scope: Edge SSR multilingual router supporting automatic Accept-Language header detection and locale path prefixes.

upstream.note: Cloudflare SSR starter. Independent locale negotiation endpoint.

entries.available_scope: Locale negotiation and path generation for a calling application.

entries.title: HTMLRewriter Edge Localizer (via Cloudflare Pages Tutorials)
entries.submitted_scope: Streams HTML responses and swaps data-i18n-key attributes in real time without client-side lag.
entries.available_scope: Replace escaped text inside matching data-i18n-key elements.

entries.title: Whisper Audio Transcription Worker (via cloudflare/templates)
entries.submitted_scope: Converts spoken foreign language audio streams into text using OpenAI Whisper on Workers AI.
entries.available_scope: Workers AI Whisper accepts raw audio. Set the owner AI secret.

entries.title: ISO-639 Language Code Resolver
entries.submitted_scope: Edge JSON microservice mapping 7,100+ living and extinct ISO 639-1, 639-2, and 639-3 language codes to regions and scripts.
entries.available_scope: ISO 639-1, 639-2 and 639-3 code and name lookup. Region and script metadata are outside this data release.

entries.title: Glottolog & WALS API Proxy
entries.submitted_scope: Caches and serves linguistic typology, family trees, and phonological inventory data at the edge.
entries.next_dependency: Glottolog and WALS snapshots with separately attributed record IDs, licenses and data update rules.

entries.title: Phonetic IPA Transcriber Worker
entries.submitted_scope: Converts Latin, Cyrillic, and Semitic text strings into International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) representations.
entries.next_dependency: Per-language grapheme-to-phoneme dictionaries or a WASM runtime with licensed models.

entries.title: Soundex & Metaphone Phonetic Matcher
entries.submitted_scope: Compares cross-language root words by phonetic resonance rather than exact spelling.
entries.available_scope: Soundex and Double Metaphone after romanization. Designed as phonetic approximations.

entries.title: Bilingual Parallel Corpus Aligner
entries.submitted_scope: Splits and aligns dual-language texts sentence-by-sentence into D1 tables.
entries.available_scope: Sentence segmentation and positional alignment. Returns unmatched sentence slots.

entries.title: Wiktionary Edge Dictionary Scraper
entries.submitted_scope: Fetches etymologies, cognates, and declensions from Wikimedia REST endpoints with KV caching.
entries.available_scope: English Wiktionary revision excerpt and section headings with page attribution.

entries.title: DeepL / LibreTranslate Hybrid Gateway
entries.submitted_scope: Routes translation payloads across multiple language APIs with automatic fallback.
entries.next_dependency: DeepL and LibreTranslate service credentials and a configured provider fallback.

entries.title: Subtitles (.SRT / .VTT) Batch Translator
entries.submitted_scope: Parses video subtitle files and translates dialogue lines while preserving exact timestamps.
entries.available_scope: Translate up to ten untagged subtitle cues with exact timestamp lines.

entries.title: Unicode Script Block Detector
entries.submitted_scope: Inspects incoming text strings and returns exact Unicode script percentages (Latin, Han, Arabic, Devanagari, Egyptian, Cuneiform).
entries.available_scope: Unicode Script counts for 30 named scripts, Common, Inherited and Other.

entries.title: Polyglot Search Stemmer
entries.submitted_scope: Normalizes inflected verb endings and plural nouns across 30+ languages before querying D1.
entries.next_dependency: Language-specific stemming implementations and search-index integration.

entries.title: Transliteration & Romanization Engine
entries.submitted_scope: Converts non-Latin scripts (Cyrillic, Greek, Hangul, Katakana, Arabic) into standardized ASCII/Latin phonetics.
entries.available_scope: Library romanization with default mappings; standards and spellings vary by language.

entries.title: Dialect & Regional Slang Normalizer
entries.submitted_scope: Maps regional variants (e.g., Levantine vs. Gulf Arabic, Iberian vs. Latin American Spanish) to root lemmas.
entries.next_dependency: Dialect-specific lexical tables with regional labels and reviewed examples.

entries.title: DigitalPasts/CuReD
entries.submitted_scope: Deep learning OCR and transliteration pipeline for Akkadian and Sumerian cuneiform tablets and museum index cards.

upstream.note: Python/Kraken human-guided OCR for printed cuneiform transliterations.

entries.next_dependency: A Python/Kraken CPU or GPU OCR service, curated scans, and explicit code/model reuse terms.

entries.title: JamesPiggott/Ancient-Language-Decipherer
entries.submitted_scope: Computer vision and NLP framework built to detect, recognize, and translate Egyptian hieroglyphs, Sumerian cuneiform, and Mayan glyphs.

upstream.note: TensorFlow 2 research code for Egyptian glyph classification.

entries.next_dependency: A Python/TensorFlow inference service, its trained artifacts, and explicit reuse terms.

entries.title: Linear B Syllabary Parser
entries.submitted_scope: Maps Mycenaean Greek Linear B Unicode characters (U+10000–U+1007F) to syllabic phonetic values.
entries.available_scope: Linear B Unicode syllabogram names and readings.

entries.title: Proto-Sinaitic & Phoenician Root Mapper
entries.submitted_scope: Traces ancient Canaanite/Phoenician abjad glyphs forward into Greek, Latin, Hebrew, and Arabic descendants.
entries.available_scope: Phoenician-to-Hebrew letter correspondences. No historical root reconstruction.

entries.title: Sumerian & Akkadian Cuneiform Unicode Converter
entries.submitted_scope: Translates ASCII sign-list transliterations into Unicode Sumero-Akkadian Cuneiform (U+12000–U+123FF).
entries.next_dependency: A versioned sign-list dataset that maps named readings and disambiguates homophones.

entries.title: Biblical Hebrew & Aramaic Strong's Lexicon API
entries.submitted_scope: Edge D1 database serving root consonants, morphological parsing, and concordance lookups.
entries.next_dependency: An ingestable lexicon and aligned Hebrew and Aramaic morphology edition with reuse terms.

entries.title: Koine & Ancient Greek Morphological Analyzer
entries.submitted_scope: Breaks down classical Greek verb tenses, cases, and root lemmas at the edge.
entries.next_dependency: An Ancient Greek morphology lexicon or service and an evaluated ambiguity policy.

entries.title: Classical Latin Declension & Conjugation Engine
entries.submitted_scope: Generates full grammatical tables and etymological roots for Latin texts.
entries.next_dependency: A Classical Latin inflection lexicon with morphological classes and exceptions.

entries.title: Old Norse & Elder Futhark Runic Transliterator
entries.submitted_scope: Converts Old Norse and English text into Elder Futhark, Younger Futhark, and Anglo-Saxon Futhorc runes.
entries.available_scope: Modern Elder Futhark character substitution.

entries.title: Ogham Celtic Tree-Alphabet Encoder
entries.submitted_scope: Translates Old Irish inscriptions into Unicode Ogham (U+1680–U+169F) notches.
entries.available_scope: Unicode Ogham letter substitution, preserving unsupported characters.

entries.title: Sanskrit Devanagari & IAST Sandhi Splitter
entries.submitted_scope: Separates compound Sanskrit words according to classical phonetic sandhi rules.
entries.next_dependency: Sanskrit splitter model or sandhi rules with an attested test corpus.

entries.title: Old Church Slavonic & Glagolitic Converter
entries.submitted_scope: Converts early Slavic texts between Glagolitic (U+2C00–U+2C5F) and early Cyrillic scripts.
entries.next_dependency: An aligned Glagolitic/early Cyrillic mapping with historical variant notes.

entries.title: Ge'ez & Ethiopic Abugida Analyzer
entries.submitted_scope: Parses classical Aksumite and liturgical Ge'ez syllabic characters.
entries.available_scope: Ethiopic base series and order for a subset of the basic block.

entries.title: Etruscan & Old Italic Inscription Indexer
entries.submitted_scope: Maps right-to-left Old Italic Unicode glyphs (U+10300–U+1032F) to attested Etruscan vocabulary.
entries.available_scope: Unicode Old Italic character names. Vocabulary and inscriptions need a corpus.

entries.title: Ugaritic Cuneiform Abjad Decoder
entries.submitted_scope: Translates 30-letter Ugaritic cuneiform tablets (U+10380–U+1039F) into Semitic root consonants.
entries.available_scope: Ugaritic letter-by-letter scholarly transcription.

entries.title: Voynich Manuscript & Undeciphered Script Entropy Analyzer
entries.submitted_scope: Computes character frequency, Zipf's law curves, and conditional entropy on unknown corpora.
entries.available_scope: Unigram and conditional entropy plus ranked frequencies.

entries.title: puzzlet/seshat
entries.submitted_scope: Programming language and algorithmic interpreter written directly in Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs.

upstream.note: Browser interpreter available at the upstream demo.

entries.next_dependency: Upstream web interpreter. Server-side execution is outside this release.

entries.title: nederhof/opentypehiero
entries.submitted_scope: Ancient Egyptian hieroglyphic Unicode and OpenType rendering engine for web documents.

upstream.note: Pinned NewGardiner font asset. Font-production tools require Python.

entries.available_scope: OpenTypeHiero pinned NewGardiner font download.

entries.title: Gardiner Sign-List Lookup Worker
entries.submitted_scope: Edge API querying all 1,071 standard Egyptian hieroglyphs by Gardiner code (e.g., A1, G17, N35), phonetic value, or determinative category.
entries.available_scope: Gardiner-code crosswalk to the assigned Egyptian Unicode glyphs.

entries.title: Manuel de Codage (MdC) to Unicode Hieroglyph Renderer
entries.submitted_scope: Converts ASCII MdC transliteration strings (nfr, ankh, m-n-t) into stacked Unicode Egyptian Hieroglyphs (U+13000–U+1342F).
entries.available_scope: Selected MdC aliases and Gardiner code transliteration.

entries.title: Egyptian Hieroglyphic Format Controls Quadrats Builder
entries.submitted_scope: Uses Unicode format controls (U+13430–U+1345F) to group horizontal and vertical glyphs into authentic square quadrats.
entries.available_scope: Unicode Egyptian format controls for explicit rows and quadrat joins.

entries.title: Cartouche & Royal Titulary Generator
entries.submitted_scope: Wraps phonetic name spellings inside SVG Egyptian royal cartouches with directional orientation.
entries.available_scope: Illustrative SVG cartouche from explicit Gardiner codes.

entries.title: Mayan Long Count & Tzolk'in Calendar Converter
entries.submitted_scope: Translates Gregorian dates into Mayan Long Count, Haab', and Tzolk'in day-sign glyphs.
entries.available_scope: GMT 584283 correlation with numeric Long Count, Tzolk’in and Haab’ labels.

entries.title: Mayan Logosyllabic Block Decoder
entries.submitted_scope: Maps Mayan epigraphic catalog codes (Thompson numbers) to phonetic syllables and logograms.
entries.next_dependency: An epigraphic catalog and licensed readings with uncertainty labels.

entries.title: Anatolian (Luwian) Hieroglyphic Sign Indexer
entries.submitted_scope: Queries Unicode Anatolian Hieroglyphs (U+14400–U+1467F) used across Hittite and Luwian monuments.
entries.available_scope: Unicode Anatolian hieroglyphic names. No epigraphic readings.

entries.title: Hieratic & Demotic Cursive Comparative Mapper
entries.submitted_scope: Links monumental hieroglyphic signs to their cursive Hieratic and Demotic descendants.
entries.next_dependency: A cited crosswalk of Hieratic and Demotic forms, periods and variants.

entries.title: Coptic Script & Egyptian Phonetic Bridge
entries.submitted_scope: Maps the 24 Greek-derived and 7 Demotic-derived Coptic letters used by Champollion to decode hieroglyphs.
entries.next_dependency: An aligned, cited Coptic-to-Egyptian historical phonology dataset.

entries.title: Rosetta Stone Trilingual Parallel Aligner
entries.submitted_scope: Serves aligned segments of Hieroglyphic, Demotic, and Ancient Greek decrees for side-by-side analysis.
entries.next_dependency: Three aligned, citable text editions of the Rosetta decree.

entries.title: Determinative & Semantic Classifier Tagging Worker
entries.submitted_scope: Identifies silent end-of-word hieroglyphs (god, king, foreign land, water, motion) to disambiguate homophones.
entries.next_dependency: An Egyptian lexicon with determinative categories and segmented word examples.

entries.title: Unicode BiDi (UAX #9) Directionality Analyzer
entries.submitted_scope: Inspects mixed strings and resolves strong/weak directional runs for Arabic, Hebrew, Syriac, and Thaana.
entries.available_scope: UAX #9 embedding levels from bidi-js with Unicode 13 data and UTF-16 offsets.

entries.title: Hieroglyphic Gaze-Direction Detector
entries.submitted_scope: Determines whether an Egyptian inscription reads RTL or LTR by checking which way human and animal glyphs face.
entries.next_dependency: An orientation-aware glyph font/image or explicit inscription metadata.

entries.title: Boustrophedon ("As the Ox Plows") Line Reverser
entries.submitted_scope: Formats and parses ancient Greek, Sabaean, and Rongorongo texts where reading direction alternates on every line.
entries.available_scope: Reverse alternating lines by grapheme, preserving line separators.

entries.title: CSS Logical Properties & HTML dir="auto" Rewriter
entries.submitted_scope: Edge HTMLRewriter Worker that automatically injects dir="rtl" and flips margins/paddings for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, and Urdu.
entries.available_scope: Set dir on the HTML root. CSS conversion is pending.

entries.title: Mixed RTL/LTR Code-Block Isolator
entries.submitted_scope: Wraps inline Latin code snippets and numbers inside <bdi> tags so they never scramble inside right-to-left paragraphs.
entries.available_scope: Escaped HTML bdi markup for an LTR fragment.

entries.title: Arabic Diacritics (Tashkeel) Stripper & Vocalizer
entries.submitted_scope: Adds or removes vowel markings (fatha, kasra, damma) for search indexing vs. recitation.
entries.available_scope: Remove Arabic-script combining marks. Vocalization requires a separate model.

entries.title: Hebrew Niqqud & Cantillation Parser
entries.submitted_scope: Strips or preserves vowel points and trope marks in biblical and modern Hebrew texts.
entries.available_scope: Independent filtering of Hebrew vowel and cantillation marks.

entries.title: Syriac Estrangela, Serto & Madnhaya Script Switcher
entries.submitted_scope: Converts right-to-left Aramaic/Syriac texts across its three classical calligraphic styles.
entries.available_scope: Select a Syriac font family for the three calligraphic styles.

entries.title: Traditional Mongolian & Manchu Top-to-Bottom Vertical Renderer
entries.submitted_scope: Applies writing-mode: vertical-lr transformations for vertical scripts.
entries.available_scope: HTML vertical-lr formatting for supplied text.

entries.title: Vertical CJK (Chinese/Japanese) Ruby Furigana Annotator
entries.submitted_scope: Formats top-to-bottom, right-to-left columns (writing-mode: vertical-rl) with phonetic ruby guides.
entries.available_scope: HTML vertical ruby markup with a caller-supplied reading.

entries.title: Mirror-Glyph & Palindrome Symmetry Checker
entries.submitted_scope: Tests character strings for horizontal, vertical, and rotational symmetry across scripts.
entries.available_scope: Grapheme reversal and palindrome test. Geometric glyph symmetry needs font outlines.

example.text: Able was I ere I saw Elba

entries.title: Arabic & Hebrew Calendar / Numeral Converter
entries.submitted_scope: Converts Western digits (0–9) to Eastern Arabic-Indic (٠–٩) and Hebrew gematria numerals.
entries.available_scope: Arabic-Indic digit conversion and Hebrew number text. Calendar conversion is available at #085.

entries.title: HistoryLabs/events-api
entries.submitted_scope: Fetches historical and mythological calendar events, births, and antiquity milestones from Wikimedia feeds.

upstream.note: Go server. Independent Wikimedia feed adapter.

entries.available_scope: Wikimedia On This Day adapter with source article URLs.

entries.title: Wikidata Mythological Entity Graph Worker
entries.submitted_scope: Queries SPARQL endpoints for deities, pantheons, sacred animals, parentage, and cultural equivalents.
entries.available_scope: Wikidata search and selected sourced relation edges by Q ID.

entries.title: Cross-Pantheon Syncretism Mapper
entries.submitted_scope: Links equivalent archetypes across Sumerian, Egyptian, Greek, Roman, Norse, Hindu, and Mesoamerican traditions (e.g., Thoth–Hermes–Mercury).
entries.next_dependency: A citable table distinguishing historically attested syncretism from comparative interpretation.

entries.title: Aarne-Thompson-Uther (ATU) Folktale Motif Classifier
entries.submitted_scope: Tags global myths and legends by standardized folklore motif numbers (flood myths, underworld descents, tricksters).
entries.next_dependency: A licensed ATU index and reviewed motif/ATU distinction.

entries.title: Hero's Journey & Monomyth Structural Parser
entries.submitted_scope: Breaks mythological narratives into Joseph Campbell's 17 archetypal stages using Workers AI.
entries.next_dependency: A narrative annotation rubric and model evaluation against human-reviewed examples.

entries.title: Sacred Geography & Ley-Line Coordinate Indexer
entries.submitted_scope: Stores ancient temples, megaliths, oracle sites, and ziggurats in D1 with geospatial distance queries.
entries.next_dependency: A georeferenced monument gazetteer with citations and coordinate confidence.

entries.title: Archaeoastronomy & Solstice Alignment Calculator
entries.submitted_scope: Computes historical star positions, precession of the equinoxes, and solar alignments for ancient monuments.
entries.next_dependency: Ephemeris and horizon data with historical precession and uncertainty parameters.

entries.title: Ancient Cosmology & Underworld Realm Mapper
entries.submitted_scope: Catalogs structural cosmologies (Duat, Kur, Tartarus, Helheim, Xibalba, Patala) and guardian entities.
entries.next_dependency: Primary-source catalog with edition, passage, and cultural attribution.

entries.title: Arthurian, Celtic & Grail Legend Concordance
entries.submitted_scope: Indexes medieval manuscripts, characters, and relics across Welsh, Breton, and French sources.
entries.next_dependency: Citable Arthurian corpora with variant witnesses and controlled entity names.

entries.title: Norse Edda & Kenning Poetic Decoder
entries.submitted_scope: Translates Old Norse poetic metaphors (kennings) into literal mythological referents.
entries.next_dependency: An Edda edition paired with a licensed kenning index and referent notes.

entries.title: Vedic & Puranic Sanskrit Epics Graph
entries.submitted_scope: Cross-references characters, astras (weapons), and genealogies across the Mahabharata and Ramayana.
entries.next_dependency: Source editions and passage-aware link data for Mahabharata, Ramayana and Puranic sources.

entries.title: Mesoamerican Codices & Creation Myth Indexer
entries.submitted_scope: Structured API for the Popol Vuh, Borgia Group codices, and Aztec Sun cycles.
entries.next_dependency: Codex facsimile and edition metadata with interpretation records linked to provenance.

entries.title: Ancient Monster, Chimera & Bestiary API
entries.submitted_scope: Searchable database of mythical creatures, hybrid attributes, and primary classical citations.
entries.next_dependency: An indexed bestiary source corpus with primary passage citations.

entries.title: Comparative Flood & Cataclysm Narrative Aligner
entries.submitted_scope: Aligns parallel verses across Atrahasis, Gilgamesh Tablet XI, Genesis, Deucalion, and Manu.
entries.next_dependency: Comparable editions and manually reviewed segment alignments.

entries.title: Mythological Etymology & English Word-Origin Finder
entries.submitted_scope: Traces modern English words back to ancient deity names (e.g., panic, cereal, martial, jovial, atlas).
entries.next_dependency: Historical etymology data with dated attestations and references.

entries.title: Oracle & Divination Corpus Engine (I Ching / Runes / Tarot)
entries.submitted_scope: Deterministic hexagram and symbol lookup engine backed by classical commentary texts.
entries.available_scope: Lookup the 64 I Ching Unicode hexagrams in King Wen order. Commentary corpora are pending.

entries.title: Gematria & Isopsephy Numerical Calculator
entries.submitted_scope: Computes Hebrew Mispar Gadol, Greek Isopsephy, and English Ordinal/Reduction values for any phrase.
entries.available_scope: English ordinal and reduction, Hebrew standard and Mispar Gadol, and Greek isopsephy.

entries.title: Classical Cipher Suite Worker (Caesar, Vigenère, Atbash, Enigma)
entries.submitted_scope: Encodes, decodes, and brute-forces historical substitution and polyalphabetic ciphers at the edge.
entries.available_scope: Caesar, Atbash and Vigenère encode/decode, plus Caesar candidate listing.

entries.title: Steganography Zero-Width Character Encoder/Decoder
entries.submitted_scope: Hides and extracts secret payloads inside plain text using invisible Unicode zero-width joiners.
entries.available_scope: Inspect commonly used zero-width and bidirectional control characters.

entries.title: CIA FOIA Reading Room & Declassified Document Searcher
entries.submitted_scope: Queries and caches declassified government archives (Project Stargate, MKUltra, UAP files) via public APIs.
entries.next_dependency: A documented stable public query endpoint or downloadable government dataset.

entries.title: Historical Conspiracy & Secret Society Knowledge Graph
entries.submitted_scope: Maps documented historical organizations, timelines, primary sources, and debunking/verification citations.
entries.next_dependency: An evidence model for claims and dated citation records with primary/secondary distinctions.

entries.title: Hermetic, Alchemical & Rosicrucian Symbol Lexicon
entries.submitted_scope: Decodes Unicode Alchemical Symbols (U+1F700–U+1F77F) and classical planetary glyphs.
entries.available_scope: Unicode alchemical and planetary symbol identification.

entries.title: Sacred Geometry & Golden Ratio (\\(\phi \\)) SVG Generator
entries.submitted_scope: Generates Metatron's Cube, Flower of Life, Sri Yantra, and Fibonacci spirals dynamically.
entries.available_scope: SVG Flower of Life seed, Metatron-style diagram and golden spiral.

entries.title: Library of Congress Chronicling America Newspaper Scraper
entries.submitted_scope: Searches historical 19th- and early 20th-century newspaper archives for suppressed or forgotten local reports.
entries.available_scope: Library of Congress page search with date filters and source URLs.

entries.title: Internet Archive Wayback Machine Diff Checker
entries.submitted_scope: Compares historical snapshots of web pages to detect silent edits, redactions, or deleted articles.
entries.available_scope: Compare Wayback CDX capture digests. Version content diffs require another stage.

entries.title: Anagram & Palindrome Permuter Engine
entries.submitted_scope: Finds hidden word rearrangements and phonetic anagrams across multi-word phrases.
entries.available_scope: Unicode-aware palindrome checks and exact normalized anagram comparison.

entries.title: Biblical & Apocryphal Dead Sea Scrolls Cross-Referencer
entries.submitted_scope: Compares canonical verses against Qumran fragments, Enoch, Jubilees, and Nag Hammadi texts.
entries.next_dependency: An authorized verse-to-fragment concordance, with Qumran and Nag Hammadi sources distinguished.

entries.title: Numerology & Calendar Synchronizer (Julian, Gregorian, Hebrew, Hijri, Mayan)
entries.submitted_scope: Converts dates simultaneously across seven historical calendar systems to spot date alignments.
entries.available_scope: Gregorian, Julian, Hebrew, Islamic civil, Persian, Coptic, Chinese and Maya date views.

entries.title: UFO / UAP Sighting Database (NUFORC / MUFON) Edge API
entries.submitted_scope: Geo-indexes historical sighting reports by date, shape, and coordinates in D1.
entries.next_dependency: NUFORC and MUFON permissions or authorized data exports with publishable fields.

entries.title: Acoustic Resonance & Solfeggio Frequency Tone Generator
entries.submitted_scope: Synthesizes WebAudio / WAV frequency tones (432 Hz, 528 Hz, Schumann 7.83 Hz) directly from Worker responses.
entries.available_scope: Generate a 16 kHz PCM WAV sine wave with a short fade at each end.

entries.title: Rumor, Meme & Narrative Propagation Tracker
entries.submitted_scope: Analyzes timestamped social/RSS feeds to trace where an idea or theory originated and how it mutated.
entries.available_scope: Chronological timeline from user-supplied RSS 2.0 or Atom XML.

entries.title: Project Gutenberg EPUB/TXT Edge Ingestor
entries.submitted_scope: Streams public-domain classic books, splits them into chapters, and indexes paragraphs into D1.
entries.available_scope: Search Gutenberg metadata via Gutendex or preview supplied TXT paragraphs and SHA-256.

entries.title: Perseus Digital Library Classics XML Parser
entries.submitted_scope: Extracts bilingual Greek/Latin and English texts from open classical repositories.
entries.available_scope: Extract TEI paragraphs and verses with XML IDs and language tags from supplied XML.

entries.title: OpenLibrary & ISBN Metadata Harvester
entries.submitted_scope: Enriches book catalogs with publication histories, subjects, and Dewey/LOC call numbers.
entries.available_scope: Open Library book search by query or ISBN.

entries.title: ArXiv & Open-Access Linguistics Preprint Crawler
entries.submitted_scope: Monitors new academic papers on computational linguistics, decipherment, and archaeology.
entries.available_scope: arXiv Atom search with bounded results.

entries.title: Vectorize Semantic Cross-Cultural Search Engine
entries.submitted_scope: Embeds texts across 50+ languages into a unified vector space so a query in English retrieves matching ancient Sumerian or Chinese passages.
entries.next_dependency: Vectorize index, embedding model, rights-cleared corpus and multilingual relevance evaluation.

entries.title: Entity-Relation Triple Extractor Worker
entries.submitted_scope: Uses Workers AI to turn raw historical prose into (Subject) -> [Predicate] -> (Object) graph triples.
entries.next_dependency: A provenance-preserving extraction schema and model evaluation with evidence spans.

entries.title: Citation & Provenance Verifier
entries.submitted_scope: Cross-checks claims against primary source URLs and attaches immutable SHA-256 content hashes.
entries.available_scope: SHA-256 of exact bytes or a supplied string. Source claims require independent evaluation.

entries.title: Noto Sans Universal Fallback Font Subsetter
entries.submitted_scope: Dynamically subsets and serves Google Noto fonts for rare scripts (Cuneiform, Hieroglyphs, Linear B, Gothic) so browsers never render missing □ boxes.
entries.available_scope: Noto stylesheet pointers for five rare scripts. Dynamic file subsetting is pending.

entries.title: SVG Stone-Carving & Papyrus Texture Renderer
entries.submitted_scope: Renders ancient inscriptions onto realistic limestone, clay tablet, or papyrus SVG cards.
entries.available_scope: Decorative stone, clay, or papyrus inscription SVG.

entries.title: Interactive Stroke-Order & Glyph Anatomy Visualizer
entries.submitted_scope: Generates animated SVG stroke paths for Chinese characters, Hangul jamo, and Arabic ligatures.
entries.available_scope: Animated stroke diagrams for four Chinese characters.

entries.title: Side-by-Side Paleography Comparison Grid
entries.submitted_scope: Displays how a single letterform (e.g., Aleph / Alpha / A) evolved visually over 4,000 years.
entries.available_scope: Side-by-side glyph forms for Aleph and Beth.

entries.title: Audio Pronunciation & TTS Reader Worker
entries.submitted_scope: Synthesizes spoken audio for foreign and reconstructed ancient words via edge TTS endpoints.
entries.available_scope: Authenticated English and Spanish Workers AI TTS. Ancient phonetic reconstructions require a separate source.

entries.title: Universal Polyglot Knowledge Gateway
entries.submitted_scope: Master dispatch Worker that routes any query through language detection, script directionality (RTL/LTR), ancient root lookup, and mythological cross-referencing in a single API call.
entries.available_scope: Combine script counts, bidi levels, optional language-code lookup and relevant shelf routes.
